legend: Nlogonia secret mathematics society helds meetings with distinguished members that are able to solve a given mathematical problem. Being one of the most prestigious mathematics societies in the region you want to participate in the meeting, they discuss in this meetings a lot of interesting problems and their solutions, and therefore, it could be also a very good place to train your algorithmic skills.

The problem to be invited to the next meeting has been posted, last month meeting they used an interesting problem that generated long lists of numbers. This time, they want you to work with some of these numbers. They will give you a number N$$$N$$$ that contains only digits from 1$$$1$$$ to 9$$$9$$$, your task is to remove a specified amount of each digit from N$$$N$$$ and get the biggest possible number. Will you be able to join this month meeting?
input: The first line of input contains a number N$$$N$$$, N$$$N$$$ will have at most 1000$$$1000$$$ digits. The second and last line of input contains 9$$$9$$$ integer numbers separated by a space, where the i$$$i$$$-th number represents the amount of times the digit i$$$i$$$ should be removed from N$$$N$$$. It is guaranteed that no digit should be removed more times than it appears in N$$$N$$$, and that in no case all digits from N$$$N$$$ should be removed.
output: Output a line containing a number, representing the biggest number you can get after removing the specified digits from N$$$N$$$.

legend.ai: Nlogonia 的秘密数学协会会邀请能够解决给定数学问题的杰出成员参加会议。作为该地区最负盛名的数学协会之一，你希望参加这些会议；他们会在会议中讨论许多有趣的问题及其解法，因此，这也可能是训练算法技能的好地方。
他们会给你一个数 N$$$N$$$，其中只包含从 1$$$1$$$ 到 9$$$9$$$ 的数字；你的任务是从 N$$$N$$$ 中删去每种数字指定的数量，从而得到可能的最大数。你能参加本月的会议吗？

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个数 N$$$N$$$，N$$$N$$$ 最多包含 1000$$$1000$$$ 位数字。输入的第二行也是最后一行，包含 9$$$9$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个数表示应从 N$$$N$$$ 中删去数字 i$$$i$$$ 的次数。保证删去任意数字的次数不会超过该数字在 N$$$N$$$ 中出现的次数，并且在任何情况下都不会删去 N$$$N$$$ 中的所有数字。

output.ai: 输出一行，其中包含一个数，表示从 N$$$N$$$ 中删去指定数量的各个数字后能够得到的最大数。
